sourceZh: 车型：Škoda Kodiaq（SORT/黑色），车牌 XR 72427 —— 已由两份官方文件确认：①Sixt 签约合同（Scrive 电子签署，07.11.2026 09:17 CET，文件 contract_WANN HOI_FONG_XR72427，车辆栏注明 SKODA KODIAQ SORT XR72427 SFBR）；②还车结算发票（Invoice 2261286，日期 24.11.2026，车辆栏注明 KODIAQ SKODA Diesel XR72427，取车 07.11.2026 09:00 里程 53,060 km，还车 22.11.2026 15:30 里程 54,871 km，全程行驶 1,811 km）。两份文件互相印证，比单纯照片判读更可靠。燃油：柴油（文件直接写明 Diesel，非猜测）。油耗按 2.0 TDI 4x4 WLTP 综合 6.0–6.6 L/100km 取上限再加约15%冬季余量 ≈ 7.6；油箱 58 L（auto-data.net，具体发动机版本以合同为准）。取车时：总里程 53,060 km，续航显示 890 km（约等于 58 L ÷ 6.5 L/100km，与满箱相符）。
sourceEn: Model: Škoda Kodiaq (black), plate XR 72427 — confirmed by two official documents: (1) the signed Sixt rental contract (e-signed via Scrive, 07.11.2026 09:17 CET, doc "contract_WANN HOI_FONG_XR72427", vehicle line reads SKODA KODIAQ SORT XR72427 SFBR); (2) the final return invoice (Invoice 2261286, dated 24.11.2026, vehicle line reads KODIAQ SKODA Diesel XR72427, pick-up 07.11.2026 09:00 at 53,060 km, return 22.11.2026 15:30 at 54,871 km, 1,811 km driven over the rental). The two documents cross-confirm each other and are more reliable than photo identification alone. Fuel: diesel, stated explicitly on the invoice (not inferred). Consumption = top of the 2.0 TDI 4x4 WLTP combined range (6.0–6.6 L/100 km) plus ~15% winter margin ≈ 7.6; tank 58 L (auto-data.net — exact engine variant per the contract). At pickup: odometer 53,060 km, range shown 890 km (≈ 58 L at 6.5 L/100 km, consistent with a full tank).
